name: Girls Bravo Romance15's
source:
Yukinari Sasaki is an average high school student who is frequently ridiculed by girls to the point that he developed an allergic reaction to them. As a result, he breaks out in hives whenever he comes into contact with a female. One day, when he returns home from school, he is kicked into his bathtub by his neighbor Kirie Kojima, but is transported to Seiren, a mysterious world with a mostly female population. He befriends Miharu Sena Kanaka, who ends up following him to Earth. Other Seiren girls with various motives soon visit and join the household. They are taken on many adventures as Miharu discovers the wonders of Earth.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Girls_Bravo#Plot]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
佐佐木雪成是一名平凡的高中生，却长期受女生捉弄，以至于对女性产生过敏反应：只要与女性接触，身上就会起荨麻疹。一天放学回家时，他被邻居小岛桐绘一脚踢进自家浴缸，却因此被传送到一个女性占绝大多数的神秘世界“西莲”。

他在那里结识了米哈露·瑟娜·卡娜卡，后来她也跟着雪成来到地球。此后，其他怀着不同目的的西莲少女陆续来访，并加入这个家庭。随着米哈露逐渐发现地球的种种奇妙之处，众人也踏上了一次又一次冒险。

[摘自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Girls_Bravo#Plot]Wikipedia[/url]]
